# Gainhelm

Gainhelm is an AI dispatch app and software for field service teams.

## What it helps with
- HVAC dispatch app / HVAC dispatch software
- Plumbing dispatch app / plumbing dispatch software
- Field service scheduling app / field service scheduling software
- Technician assignment, service call scheduling, and route planning
- Emergency job intake and dispatch workflows for plumbing, HVAC, and restoration teams
- Replacing phone tag, spreadsheets, and messy handoffs

## Quick summary
Gainhelm helps HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, and restoration teams turn incoming jobs into a cleaner schedule, assign technicians faster, and keep the workday organized. It is software for service businesses, not an emergency plumbing or water-damage provider for homeowners.
